tripHistoryEmptyDescription: Start a trip on the dashboard, then finish it to keep the statistics and optional route on this device.
tripNotFound: This trip is no longer available.
deleteTripMessage: This permanently removes its statistics and saved route from this device. Your total odometer and calendar distance totals are kept. Exported files are not deleted.
tripRouteDescription: Offline map with coarse land outlines. Pinch to zoom and drag to explore. Streets are not included. Breaks mark pauses or periods without a saved route.
tripNoRoute: No route was saved. Speed samples and statistics are still available.
tripSpeedGraphDescription: Speed samples are shown against elapsed trip time. Gaps separate pauses and missing GPS intervals.
tripNoSamples: No accepted GPS samples were recorded.
tripReplayDescription: Replay follows the saved samples. Dashed segments and warning markers identify samples above the speed limit selected during recording.
tripExportDisclosure: Exports can include precise saved coordinates. Only share them with apps and people you trust.
tripRouteSemantics: Saved route with start, end and replay position markers
tripBasemapAttribution: Land outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). Coarse global basemap; streets are not included.
